issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() to return a double, but the solution implementation defines getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning an int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to compilation/test failures if they follow the specification (double) while the provided solution uses int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent with the UML/specification. Either change the solution method signature to public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() and implement it as: return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); or update the problem statement/UML to specify an int return type if an integer result is intended.
